names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 13 februarie.
Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 14 iulie, «Sfântul Apostol Achila», with the rank word left off; the life page spells him «Acvila» in its prose.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιοι Ακύλας και Πρίσκιλλα οι Απόστολοι», with the rank words left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

feast.note: doxologia.ro also keeps him on 14 iulie, «Sfantul Apostol Achila», with a life of its own and a troparion; that page and this one are the same man -- the Jew of Pontus, the tent-maker, the husband of Priscilla, driven from Rome by Claudius and baptised by Paul (read 24 September 2026). One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 13 februarie — «Sfinți Apostoli și Mucenici Acvila și soția sa, Priscila»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιοι Ακύλας και Πρίσκιλλα οι Απόστολοι»

attestations.note: The page closes with a second day for him alone: «O Άγιος Aκύλας εορτάζεται και στις 14 Ιουλίου» — Aquila is kept also on 14 July. One attestation row is one feast, so the row records the day read and the second day stands here as a note; the page gives Priscilla no second day.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Apostole sfinte Achila, roagă pe milostivul Dumnezeu, ca să dăruiască iertare de greşeli sufletelor noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Apostol Achila, unul din cei șaptezeci», Glasul 3

english.text: Holy apostle Aquila, pray the merciful God that He grant our souls forgiveness of our offences.

hymns.text: Χριστὸν ἀγαπήσαντες καὶ φωτισθέντες τὸν νοῦν, τὴ πίστει ἐνούμενοι καὶ συζυγία σεμνή, Ἀκύλας καὶ Πρισκίλλα ἤσαν μὲν προεστῶτες ἐκκλησίας κατ’ οἶκον, Παύλου δὲ τοῦ φωστῆρος συνεργοὶ καὶ προστᾶται. Διὸ αὐτοὺς τιμήσωμεν καὶ μιμησώμεθα.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε, on the page of Άγιος Ακύλας ο Απόστολος and Αγία Πρίσκιλλα. One hymn for the pair, naming both; the itacism «τὴ πίστει» is the page's own.

english.text: Having loved Christ and been enlightened in mind, united in the faith and in an honourable marriage, Aquila and Priscilla were heads of a church in their own house, and fellow workers and protectors of Paul the light-giver. Therefore let us honour them and imitate them.
